MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH o.nationality AS nationality,
     CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN STRPTIME(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') ELSE STRPTIME(o.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y') END AS birth_date
WITH nationality,
     2026 - CAST(DATE_PART('year', birth_date) AS INT64) - CASE

         OR (CAST(DATE_PART('month', birth_date) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(DATE_PART('day', birth_date) AS INT64) > 14)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2

     CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)

          WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS 'April' THEN 4
          WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS 'May' THEN 5
          WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS 'June' THEN 6
          WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS 'July' THEN 7
          WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS 'August' THEN 8

          WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS 'November' THEN 11

     CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(REPLACE(split_part(o.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64) END AS birth_day
